title: MBT aggregate identity and standard dispatch weight
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); latest user instruction supplies 2600 lb per cubic yard

setup.artifacts: Only in the disposable runner artifact directory

setupAmendment: Browser verification uses the existing test-e2e build target with the standard isolated Compose limits, wrapped in the repository retention runner. No new packages.
scenarios: An aggregate created without density receives 2600 lb per cubic yard; supplied historical positive density is normalized to that standard.
Local-item and Front Desk configuration display the same 2600 lb standard for existing material records, without rewriting historical charge snapshots.
The aggregate creation form supplies the standard automatically and does not require a density decision.
GRAVEL and other valid configured local item codes do not require an AGG_ prefix; malformed, overlong, and duplicate identities remain rejected.
Two yards of configured GRAVEL at CAD 60 per yard produce a CAD 120 material line and 5200 lb dispatch weight, including when its stored legacy density is 1300.
A material without an active per-yard price remains rejected; density does not bypass rate validation.
Existing quoted prices, tax calculation, payment rules, and already stored charge snapshots remain unchanged. The pure calculator can still replay an explicit historical density.

failureModel.risk: wrong dispatch weight or pounds/kilograms confusion
failureModel.check: exact 5200 lb integration assertion, randomized quantity properties

failureModel.risk: accepting an unpriced item or invalid identity
failureModel.check: missing-price integration case and adversarial identity cases
existing customer-charge calculator and workflow suites plus exact material-extension assertion
